This app runs inside the toolbox and can use permissions granted to the host. Only developer-signed packages compatible with this host version are accepted.
Uninstalling stops the app and removes its executable code. Local data and settings are retained for reinstallation. Uninstall this app?

Apps are downloaded from GitHub and run inside the toolbox. Uninstalling retains personal data, which can be deleted separately in Global settings. Weather and Status are installed by default and can be removed; Settings and App store are permanent.
pre-3.0.0-1 · App home and module installation

Adds an icon-based home screen and a GitHub app store. Weather and Status are installed by default. Apps can be installed, opened and uninstalled; in-host app data is retained. Includes coordinated icons and installation-aware settings and permissions. This is a 3.0.0 test host; shared resources and base services remain in the host.
